text:
tara: kicking off a config-only change tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. delta: global_request_timeout_ms 1000->850, batch_max_tokens 2048->1536, routing.fallback_priority added (priority=low->degraded first). no model change. @yves @sre-oncall please ACK so deploy-bot can queue canary.
deploy-bot: Job queued: config-update/1798765432. Canary: 3% traffic, 20m observation, health checks + smoke. Auto-rollback: p99 latency +250ms or error rate >0.8%. Change window: 02:00-03:00 UTC.
yves: ACK. Quick note: enterprise tenants must keep priority=low pinned until next maintenance (they're on model v3.1). We'll add tenant.pin for enterprise in config.
tara: adding tenant.pin: enterprise -> priority=low, model=v3.1. Also switching batch_max_tokens to 1600 (compromise).
sre-oncall: prefer 1600 too. earlier lab run with 1536 caused higher tail for small requests. I'll add a temporary alert: tail_latency.alert if p99 > 1s.
deploy-bot: Job updated: config-update/1798765432.v2. Canary start scheduled 02:00 UTC. Hooks: smoke, p99, error-rate, tail_latency.alert.
yves: productops FYI: release note blurb below: "Config-only: lowered global request timeout to 850ms to reduce queuing, adjusted batch_max_tokens to 1600 to balance KV usage, introduced routing.fallback_priority with enterprise pinned to low priority. Monitoring/rollback in place." Thoughts?
productops: looks good. Add a line about no model updates and affected tenants list.
tara: good call, will add tenant list and link to changelog. Plan: if canary stays green 02:15 -> ramp 30% at 02:20 -> 70% at 02:35 -> 100% by 02:50. Manual holds at each step.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:00 UTC (1798765460). Metrics stream: https://obs.redwood/internal/streams/1798765432
deploy-bot: 02:10 update: error-rate 0.05%, p99 +110ms, tail_latency 0.22%.
sre-oncall: seeing a small increase in IO for nodes handling large batches. Not critical but watching.
yves: two tenants in enterprise reported slower responses in sandbox, but no errors. They were pinned so unaffected by routing changes.
tara: proceeding to 30% at 02:20 if no objections.
deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 30% at 02:20 UTC. Monitoring ongoing.
deploy-bot: 02:30 update: error-rate 0.12%, p99 +140ms, tail_latency 0.38%, IO utilization +6% on subset. No rollback triggers hit.
productops: draft release note updated and pushed to #release-notes. added affected tenant list.
sre-oncall: adding follow-up ticket INF-358 to investigate IO bump; not a blocker.
yves: can we add a quick fallback plan if p99 jumps? i.e., immediate re-pin routing.policy to tiered for default route and abort rollout.
tara: yes. adding manual rollback step and deploy-bot abort hook.
deploy-bot: Abort hook added. Canary continue.
deploy-bot: 02:45 update: traffic 70%, error-rate 0.15%, p99 +155ms, tail_latency 0.45%. Still under thresholds.
tara: hold at 70 for 5m, watching infra dashboard.
sre-oncall: hold acknowledged. setting alert escalation if tail_latency >0.6%.
deploy-bot: 02:52 final ramp to 100%. Rollout complete at 02:54 UTC. No auto-rollbacks.
yves: verified tenant pins are intact in final config.
productops: release notes published, changelog entry made, and a postmortem ticket created to track INF-358.
sre-oncall: follow-up: please validate kvcache hit rates tomorrow; slight degradation noted during ramp.
tara: acknowledged. adding to INF-358. Closing thread. :shipit:
